name: Gluttonworm

source.title: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star

items.name: Dune Dispersal
items.text: 15 feet. Ground in the aura is greater difficult terrain.

items.name: Inexorable
items.text:
The gluttonworm recovers from the Paralyzed, Slowed, and Stunned conditions at the end of its turn.

It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the Immobilized condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

items.name: Sand Armor
items.text:
A gluttonworm in contact with a significant body of sand, such as a desert or beach, gains fast healing 10.

If the gluttonworm is subject to persistent bleed, the flowing blood quickly congeals with the sand covering its body, instantly ending the bleed duration and giving the gluttonworm a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Fast Swallow
items.text:
Trigger The gluttonworm Grabs a creature, or a creature fails a Reflex save against a Gulping Charge

---

Effect The gluttonworm uses Swallow Whole.

items.name: Gulping Charge
items.text:
The gluttonworm Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures, gulping each creature whose space the worm enters and attempting a body Strike against each of them.

The gluttonworm can use this Strike on each creature only once in a single use of Gulping Charge. Creatures can attempt a DC 41 basic Reflex save save against this damage.

items.name: Spew Sandstorm
items.text:
The gluttonworm exhales swirling sand in a 60-foot cone. Creatures in the area must attempt a DC 41 Reflex save save.

It can't Spew Sandstorm again for 1d4 rounds.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 4d6 slashing damage and 4d6 bludgeoning damage from the scouring sand.

Failure The creature takes 8d6 slashing damage and 8d6 bludgeoning damage from the sand, and is Dazzled until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes 12d6 slashing damage and 12d6 bludgeoning damage and is Blinded for 1 hour.

text: Akiton's gluttonworms share many features of Golarion's cave worms, yet these immense predators are their own distinct species. Gluttonworms "swim" through the vast deserts of Akiton, moving almost like whales through the ocean as they forage for their next meals.
